title: Concept: Dependency marked as changing
description: build.gradle declares a dependency whose artifact may change under the same coordinates, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency whose artifact may change under the same coordinates.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency whose artifact may change under the same coordinates.
